name: global-connect
description: Turn a real human request into a shareable card and measure whether routing it through people and communities produces useful help.

interface.shortDescription: Create and route a real request through people and communities
interface.longDescription: Create a portable public-link request card, preserve its real source and success criteria, and measure aggregate routing outcomes. Authorized operators can additionally register and inspect individual distribution routes without exposing private responder contacts.
defaultPrompt: Draft a Global Connect card for this real-world request.
Create a public Global Connect card from this request and return the link.
Check the aggregate routing results for this Global Connect request ID.
